title: Menu session: Settings > Audio/Video options (open it twice, change values, leave)
summary: A short menu census of the Audio/Video options screen (T1566, follow-up of the T1496 crash that the owner reported fixed on 2026-10-07). Two labelled phases in one game run: first scroll through EVERY option and change a few values, then reopen the screen, check the values were kept and leave. Also a crash check: the screen must not stop the game. The script has no idle control phase, so the analysis pools the navigation parts between the phases.
duration: about 3 minutes after the game window opens
prerequisites: Game HDD: tmp/hdds/profile-hdd (it holds your profile). A new timestamped folder tmp/owner-profiles/menu-av-<time> is made on every run, so a re-run never overwrites an earlier one.
No route and no Map Maker: you drive by hand from the start screen.

menu-audio-video.title: Audio/Video options: scroll through every option and change some
menu-audio-video.go_to: Main Menu > Settings > Audio/Video options (select the entry but do not scroll yet)
menu-audio-video.do: Scroll down and up through EVERY option once. Change a few values: toggle one setting and move a volume slider a few steps. Accept or apply, then back out to Settings. Do not open Controls.
menu-audio-video.note: which options the screen has and which ones you changed (names and old and new value)

menu-audio-video-leave.title: Audio/Video options: reopen, check, leave
menu-audio-video-leave.go_to: Main Menu > Settings (you just left Audio/Video)
menu-audio-video-leave.do: Reopen Audio/Video options, check that the values you changed are still set, back out to Settings, then back out to the Main Menu.
menu-audio-video-leave.note: whether the changed values were kept or reverted

steps: When the window opens: choose your player count and profile and go to the Main Menu. Then Settings. Do NOT enter Audio/Video yet, the first prompt tells you when.
Between the phases the game keeps running, you can take your time. Stay in the Settings menu until the next prompt.
Finish: the tool closes the game and prints the analysis.
note_at_end: Did the game crash, freeze or glitch (sound or picture) in the Audio/Video screen? If it stopped, copy the 'unimplemented instruction at ...' or 'STOP' line the script prints.
Anything unexpected in the options (a missing option, a slider that did nothing).
stop: At each phase prompt: Enter starts and Enter ends the phase, s skips it, q finishes the session. The phases do not stop by themselves.
After the last phase the tool closes the game by itself. Do not close the window before then.
send_back: Tell Claude the session finished: folder tmp/owner-profiles/menu-av-<time> (the script prints it).
The crash check lines at the end ('crash check (last stop lines)'), and your notes above.
